stylesheets: Only what the brought pages use: 9 of patchbay.help's stylesheets, cut to the rules those pages use. Each file is wrapped in @scope (:root[data-product="patchbay"]:has(.pb-frame)) to (.regents-frame): it stops at regents.sh's frame, and :has(.pb-frame) keeps it off the /patchbay overview, which is regents.sh's own page; :root reads :scope. The base reset sits in the site's regents-base layer, under the site's own rules. patchbay.help sets no product on its page, so its main button, link, focus and chosen colours are restated per theme from Regent UI 69dbfface, with the button's corner marks back to the shared ones, so they win over Regent UI's Patchbay product colours. The sheet's focus ring is the site's own rule, the same as patchbay.help's; only the skip link's ring is restated. The theme switch and the phone menu are the bar's, so theme_switch.css and the menu rules are not brought.
